# Intergrax — Full LLM Context Map

> Extended project map for LLM agents, crawlers, and automated documentation tools.
> Canonical source of truth: `docs/` — this file summarizes and routes; it does not replace canon.

---

## Project identity

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **Name** | Intergrax |
| **Tagline** | Agent OS and Harness AI runtime |
| **Language** | Python 3.12 |
| **Package** | Intergrax-ai (pyproject.toml) |
| **Repository** | https://github.com/jakbuczarnecki/intergrax-ai |
| **Maintainer** | Artur Czarnecki |
| **Status** | Active private R&D; harness platform complete |
| **License** | Proprietary — see LICENSE |

### One-line thesis

> Can we rapidly create, run, and evaluate new AI agents without rebuilding infrastructure every time?

### Strategic goal

Build a **modern, production-grade Harness AI** and **Agent Operating System**. Source: docs/INTERGRAX_DEVELOPMENT_STRATEGY.md

---

## Four-tier architecture

```text
Tier-3  applications/     →  deployable products
Tier-2  agents/           →  specialized capability modules
Tier-1  intergrax/runtime/ →  Nexus Agent OS (NexusLoop, AgentEngine, UAEP)
Tier-0  intergrax/        →  integrations, tools, skills, LLM, RAG, memory
```

### Mandatory dependency rules

```text
intergrax/       MUST NOT import from agents/ or applications/
agents/          MUST NOT import from applications/
applications/    MAY import from agents/ and intergrax/
```
